stem.text: A spring of spring constant $30\,\text{N m}^{-1}$ is suspended vertically from its top. The spring obeys Hooke’s law. Initially the spring is not compressed and not stretched. A mass of $0.50\,\text{kg}$ is attached to the bottom of the spring. The mass is released from rest and falls.
In the motion that follows, what is the maximum extension of the spring?
